text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week appears to be a little
under the
weather. I take her to the
infirmary so she can get
some rest.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer! Once I rest up here,
all my
exhaustion should be gone in a
jiffy!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
What? Wait a second. Are you who I
think you
are? The Three Goddesses?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um, hello to you, divine Three
Goddesses! I wish
to become the top
Umamusume in all of Japan...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Three Goddesses appear to smile
upon
hearing Special Week's words.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At that moment, a bright light floods the
room.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Oh, it was just a dream...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Wait. I don't know why, but I think I
feel better
now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her vigor restored, Special Week leaves
the
infirmary with a spring in her step.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week's wish doesn't seem to
reach the
ears of the Three Goddesses,
and they depart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At that moment, a bright light floods the
room.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Oh... It was all a dream... But it
felt so
real...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unable to forget the dream she had,
Special
Week fails to get proper rest.
